content.title: Morning Pottery Process | Throwing, Painting, Series Proof and Cleanup
content.summary: An adult potter shapes, paints and groups a tea-cup series before washing away clay. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult craftsperson and one workshop persist. + Each craft stage visibly changes the object. + Decoration follows a stable vessel state. + The group shot proves a finished series. + Hand washing follows and confirms the completed process.
quick_start.recommended_input: One clearly adult animated potter shapes one clay tea cup on a single wheel in warm morning light. Paint one blue branch and five small blossoms on the same fired cup in a stable close view. Follow her through the open door to one basin, where she washes visible clay from both hands under running water.

creative_dna.mechanism: 同一成年动画陶艺师在暖光作坊完成拉坯塑形、杯体稳定、蓝花描绘和成组摆放；终局从成品桌自然过渡到门外水池洗手，以可见泥水残留证明工序完成。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult craftsperson and one workshop persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult craftsperson and one workshop persist."

invariants.rule: Each craft stage visibly changes the object.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each craft stage visibly changes the object."

invariants.rule: Decoration follows a stable vessel state.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Decoration follows a stable vessel state."

invariants.rule: The group shot proves a finished series.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The group shot proves a finished series."

invariants.rule: Hand washing follows and confirms the completed process.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "Hand washing follows and confirms the completed process."
